title: Premier Spend Allowance — Tailwise Plus Premier Annual Upgrades (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus)
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** On a move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, a Premier spend allowance — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the upgrade charge according to the membership's net qualifying spend over the last 12 months: its points-earning qualifying spend dated in the last 12 months less its points-reversal qualifying spend dated in the same period.

| Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months | Premier spend allowance |
|---|---|
| $1500.00 or more | $12.00 |
| $800.00 or more, below $1500.00 | $6.00 |
| below $800.00 | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical).** $1499.99: $6.00; $1500.00: $12.00; $799.99: none; $800.00: $6.00.

**Netting (hypothetical).** Earnings of $1,560.00 with a reversal of $120.00 give $1,440.00: $6.00.
